newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan dinar overnight rates stable, 3.00-4.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan dinar overnight rates stable, 3.00-4.75 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were steady on Monday, still fluctuating in a wide 3.00-4.75 percent range, with ample funds weighing down on the market, bankers said.

They said the market, after tightening slightly on Saturday to an average 5.00 percent, eased with lower than expected subscription in the latest 15 million dinar ($21 million) CD (certificate of deposits) issue.
Start of monthly salary transfers by state ministries into the banking system also helped inject further liquidity and add to overall downward pressures, bankers said.
